title: Positive Testing - LTE and 5G NSA Attach and Detach of Single UE
description: Validate successful LTE and 5G NSA attach and detach procedures for a single UE under excellent radio conditions with 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single cell environment with only one active UE.
Excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6 (LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP).
All other cells powered off and serving cell activated and unloaded.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and activate serving cell.
Place UE (real or emulated) under excellent radio conditions.
Ensure end-to-end LTE or 5G NSA setup is operational with no connectivity issues.
Start log capture for call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON UE to perform attach to LTE or 5G NSA cell.
Wait for successful attach confirmation (attach complete).
Power OFF UE to initiate detach.
Wait for successful detach confirmation (detach accept).
Stop and save logs.
Repeat steps 4 to 9 for a total of 10 iterations.
Record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency metrics.
expectedResults: Attach success rate of 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate of 100% over 10 iterations.
Attach latency recorded with minimum, average, and maximum values.
UE is attached to the correct cell (PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN) as per configuration.
Signaling messages confirm successful attach and detach procedures per 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340 specifications.
postconditions: UE detached and network resources released.
Logs stored for KPI and gap analysis.
verificationMethods: Check UE logs/applications for correct cell attachment details.
Validate signaling message flows for attach and detach procedures.
Verify recorded KPIs in Table 5-2 and latency in Table 5-3.

title: Negative Testing - Attach and Detach Failure and Recovery
description: Test UE behavior and network responses when attach or detach procedures fail during LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach sequences.
preconditions: Single cell environment as per test setup.
Simulated radio condition degradation to cause attach or detach failures.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup and place UE under poor or fluctuating radio conditions.
Start log capture.
Power ON UE to initiate attach procedure.
Induce failure scenarios such as delayed or missing attach complete message.
Observe network and UE retry or recovery mechanisms.
Power OFF UE to initiate detach procedure during failure states.
Simulate failure in detach accept message or signaling drop.
Observe recovery or timeout behavior.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: UE and network retry attach or detach procedures according to protocol.
Failures are logged and detected.
Recovery mechanisms restore correct attach-detach state or report failure gracefully.
No resource leaks or inconsistent UE states remain.
Appropriate error messages or alarms are generated.
postconditions: UE either successfully attached/detached after retries or remains in correct failure state.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for failed attach/detach attempts and retry messages.
Check UE state transitions in logs.
Verify error and alarm generation in system monitoring.

title: Edge Case Testing - Minimum Coupling Loss Boundary for Excellent Radio Conditions
description: Test attach and detach procedures with UE placed at radio conditions exactly at the minimum coupling loss threshold defined in Clause 4.6.
preconditions: Single cell test environment with UE positioned to achieve minimum coupling loss.
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Set up test environment with variable attenuator or fading generator to achieve minimum coupling loss boundary.
Place UE (real/emulated) under these conditions.
Start log capture.
Power ON UE and perform attach procedure.
Wait for attach completion and validate.
Power OFF UE and perform detach procedure.
Wait for detach completion and validate.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach complete successfully at minimum coupling loss boundary.
Attach and detach success rates meet 100% criteria.
No unexpected degradation in latency or signaling.
UE is attached to the correct cell.
postconditions: Logs stored for performance at boundary.
verificationMethods: Validate signaling flows for attach and detach.
Verify radio parameters (RSRP, SS-RSRP) meet minimum coupling loss limits.
Check KPIs for latency and success rates.

title: Performance Testing - Attach and Detach Latency Under Load
description: Measure attach and detach latency and success rates during repeated attach-detach cycles under load and stress conditions for LTE and 5G NSA.
preconditions: Single cell with one UE as per setup.
Capability to measure and record latency accurately.
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Configure test as per setup with excellent radio conditions.
Start log capture.
Repeat attach-detach procedure 10 times sequentially without delay.
Record attach request to attach complete latency for each iteration.
Record detach request to detach accept latency for each iteration.
Repeat test with reduced radio quality or added interference to simulate stress.
Collect and analyze latency distribution (min, avg, max).
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate remains near or at 100% under load.
Latency values remain within acceptable thresholds as per KPI targets.
Latency distribution is consistent without outliers indicating instability.
Logs contain accurate timestamps for latency measurement.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for latency timings.
Calculate min, average, and max latency values.
Compare results against KPI targets in Table 5-3.

title: Security Testing - Authentication and Authorization During Attach and Detach
description: Verify that the attach and detach procedures enforce proper authentication and authorization as per 3GPP specifications.
preconditions: Test environment with real or emulated UE supporting authentication.
Network configured with authentication and authorization policies.
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Configure UE with valid credentials and start log capture.
Power ON UE and initiate attach procedure.
Verify authentication messages exchanged (e.g., Authentication Request/Response).
Confirm UE is authorized to attach to the network.
Power OFF UE and initiate detach procedure.
Verify detach request and acceptance with proper authorization checks.
Attempt attach with invalid credentials and observe rejection.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: UE with valid credentials successfully attaches and detaches.
Authentication and authorization messages are exchanged correctly.
UE with invalid credentials is rejected during attach.
No unauthorized access to network resources.
Logs contain authentication success/failure records.
postconditions: Network security state consistent after attach/detach attempts.
verificationMethods: Inspect signaling logs for authentication message flows.
Check authorization decision points in network.
Verify rejection of unauthorized attach attempts.

title: Integration Testing - MN Initiated Secondary Node Release Procedure
description: Validate the MN initiated Secondary Node Release procedure including signaling message flows and resource release as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup with MN and SN configured.
UE attached to EN-DC (LTE + 5G).
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Start log capture.
MN initiates Secondary Node Release by sending SgNB Release Request message to SN.
SN responds with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge message.
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration.
UE performs SCG release or reconfiguration failure procedure if unable to comply.
SN sends SN Status Transfer message for bearers using RLC AM.
Data forwarding from SN to MN starts as applicable.
SN sends Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message to MN.
If applicable, path update procedure is initiated.
Upon UE Context Release message reception, SN releases radio and C-plane resources.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages exchanged successfully.
UE releases SCG configuration as instructed.
SN status and data usage reports sent correctly.
Resources at SN released properly without impacting ongoing data forwarding.
No signaling errors or unexpected UE behavior.
Logs confirm procedure steps and message timings.
postconditions: UE remains attached to MN only.
verificationMethods: Validate signaling message flows in logs.
Check UE behavior for SCG release confirmation.
Confirm resource release on SN.
Verify data forwarding and usage reports.

title: Integration Testing - SN Initiated Secondary Node Release Procedure
description: Validate the SN initiated Secondary Node Release procedure including signaling message flows and resource release as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup with MN and SN configured.
UE attached to EN-DC (LTE + 5G).
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Start log capture.
SN initiates release by sending SgNB Release Required message to MN.
MN responds with SgNB Release Confirm message, providing data forwarding addresses if applicable.
SN starts data forwarding and stops user data delivery to UE.
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE for SCG release.
UE performs reconfiguration or failure procedure.
SN sends SN Status Transfer message for bearers using RLC AM.
SN sends Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message to MN.
If applicable, path update procedure initiated.
SN releases radio and C-plane resources upon UE Context Release message reception.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: SgNB Release Required and Confirm messages exchanged successfully.
UE releases SCG configuration as instructed.
SN status and data usage reports sent correctly.
Resources at SN released properly without impacting ongoing data forwarding.
No signaling errors or unexpected UE behavior.
Logs confirm procedure steps and message timings.
postconditions: UE remains attached to MN only.
verificationMethods: Validate signaling message flows in logs.
Check UE behavior for SCG release confirmation.
Confirm resource release on SN.
Verify data forwarding and usage reports.

title: Usability Testing - Clarity and Repeatability of Attach-Detach Test Procedure
description: Evaluate the clarity, simplicity, and user experience of the attach-detach test procedure steps for LTE and 5G NSA in lab and field setups.
preconditions: Test engineers familiar with test documentation.
Access to test setup and UE emulator or real UE.
testSteps: Follow the test procedure steps as documented for LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach tests.
Document any ambiguities, missing details, or confusing instructions.
Attempt to reproduce the test procedure independently without additional guidance.
Collect feedback on ease of setup, test execution, and logging steps.
Evaluate documentation for completeness on configuration recording and KPI capture.
Suggest improvements for clearer instructions or tooling support.
expectedResults: Test procedure is easy to understand and follow without ambiguity.
Test steps enable reliable repeatability of attach-detach cycles.
Documentation clearly specifies requirements for radio conditions and setup.
Logging and KPI measurement steps are straightforward.
Recommendations for improvements are identified if any usability gaps found.
verificationMethods: User feedback and observations during test execution.
Review of test logs and reports for completeness.
Assessment of documentation clarity.

title: Compatibility Testing - Attach-Detach Across Different Network Versions and Environments
description: Verify attach and detach success rates and signaling correctness across different LTE and 5G NSA network versions and various lab and field environments.
preconditions: Deployment of test setup in multiple environments: lab with RF shielded box, lab with fading generator, field with radiated eNB/gNB antennas.
Different network software versions and configurations available.
Test configuration recorded for each environment/version.
testSteps: Configure test setup for each environment and network version.
Place UE under excellent radio conditions as per environment capabilities.
Perform attach and detach procedures 10 times per configuration.
Capture signaling logs and KPIs for each test.
Compare attach/detach success rates and latencies across versions and environments.
Identify any version or environment-specific issues.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates meet 100% criteria consistently across versions and environments.
Latency KPIs remain within expected ranges.
No version or environment causes unexpected failures or regressions.
Logs demonstrate proper signaling flows per 3GPP specifications.
postconditions: UE detached and network resources released after each test.
verificationMethods: Cross-environment KPI comparison.
Signaling trace analysis per environment/version.
Error and failure logs review.

title: Mandatory Registration Test - 5G NSA Registration Procedure
description: Validate that the UE successfully completes the 5G NSA registration procedure including Registration Request, Registration Accept, and Registration Complete signaling.
preconditions: 5G NSA test network configured and operational.
UE configured with valid subscription and credentials.
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Start log capture for signaling messages.
Power ON UE to initiate registration procedure.
UE sends Registration Request message to network.
Network processes request and sends Registration Accept message.
UE sends Registration Complete message confirming registration.
Monitor logs for successful message exchanges and status.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Registration Request is sent and received correctly.
Registration Accept received by UE indicating successful registration.
Registration Complete sent by UE confirming registration.
No errors or retries during registration process.
UE registered with correct network parameters.
postconditions: UE remains registered and ready for service.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for Registration Request, Accept, and Complete messages.
Verify network and UE status post registration.
Check for error or retry messages.

title: Mandatory PDU Session Test - 5G NSA PDU Session Establishment Procedure
description: Validate the 5G NSA PDU Session establishment including PDU Session Establishment Request, PDU Session Authentication, PDU Session Accept, User Plane Setup, and N3 Tunnel Creation.
preconditions: 5G NSA test network with SMF and UPF configured.
UE attached and registered on the network.
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Start log capture.
UE sends PDU Session Establishment Request to SMF.
SMF performs PDU Session Authentication if applicable.
SMF sends PDU Session Accept to UE.
Setup user plane resources including UPF and establish N3 tunnel.
Verify QoS flow establishment and resource allocations.
Monitor signaling for N11 and N4 interface interactions.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: PDU Session Establishment Request is correctly processed.
Authentication succeeds if required.
PDU Session Accept received by UE.
User plane setup completes successfully with N3 tunnel creation.
QoS flows are properly configured.
Session release procedures can be initiated and completed cleanly.
No signaling errors or failures.
Logs confirm procedure steps and resource allocations.
postconditions: PDU session active with user plane resources allocated.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling messages for PDU session establishment.
Check SMF and UPF logs for session setup.
Verify user plane path and QoS flows.
Validate N11 and N4 interface messages.

title: Mandatory Handover Test - 5G NSA Inter-gNB Handover Procedure
description: Validate the 5G NSA Inter-gNB handover including Measurement Report, Handover Required, Handover Request, Handover Request Ack, RRC Reconfiguration, Path Switch, and Handover Complete signaling.
preconditions: 5G NSA test network with multiple gNBs configured.
UE attached and registered on source gNB.
Test configuration recorded.
testSteps: Start log capture.
UE sends Measurement Report indicating need for handover.
Source gNB sends Handover Required message to target gNB.
Target gNB responds with Handover Request Ack.
Source gNB sends RRC Reconfiguration to UE for handover.
UE performs handover and sends Handover Complete message.
Source gNB initiates Path Switch procedure with core network.
Monitor signaling for all handover messages.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Measurement Report sent and received correctly.
Handover Required and Request Ack messages exchanged successfully.
UE receives and applies RRC Reconfiguration for handover.
UE successfully completes handover and informs network.
Path Switch completes, and UE context updated in core network.
No handover failures or dropped connections.
Logs confirm complete handover signaling flow.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for handover messages.
Check UE state transitions in logs.
Verify core network context update.
Confirm no call drops or failures.
